integrity: The universal lower bound is proved for arbitrary positive admissible weights before the symmetric optimizer is introduced. Finite computation is used only as a stress test, not as proof of the infinite parameter statement.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the standard pineapple graph: one clique vertex carries all pendant leaves. It uses the fixed-combinatorial-distance weighted Lin--Lu--Yau curvature convention and does not address generalized pineapple attachments or other weighted transport metrics.
title: Exact curvature-distortion number of pineapple graphs
